cells: Operator-generated Grok Imagine room-surface photos, session `01a0c701-2de0-7c91-b7b0-4b81a622ad55` (`/Users/patrick/.grok/sessions/%2FVolumes%2Ffiles%2Fsrc%2Fopenclinxr/01a0c701-2de0-7c91-b7b0-4b81a622ad55/images/`): `2.jpg` (parabolic-louver troffer), `4.jpg` (acoustic ceiling tile field, 4x4 tiles), `5.jpg` (maple door leaf with narrow lite + lever), `7.jpg` (beige sheet-vinyl/plank floor). Shipped into the repo as `packages/openclinxr/factory-stations/src/room_clinic_finish/textures/ceiling-acoustic-tile.jpg`, `floor-vinyl.jpg`, `door-maple.jpg`, `troffer-light.jpg` (re-encoded JPEG q85, dimensions unchanged; all sources already within 1024-2048px on the long edge).

**OPERATOR-GENERATED — not third-party.** The operator produced these images with Grok Imagine and approved them as the room realism reference (Entry 115 dual-90 work; `render_clinic_wc.py` maps CEILING_IMG=4.jpg, FLOOR_IMG=7.jpg, DOOR_IMG=5.jpg, LIGHT_IMG=2.jpg). No external licence applies; no attribution obligation. Recorded here so the byte lineage of the shipped station textures is explicit.

4 station photo textures consumed by `room_clinic_finish/compose.py` (ceiling/floor Object-space tiling, maple door-leaf UV, emissive troffer card); folded into the room Cycles bake via DIFFUSE COLOR (bake runs with `--no-restore-albedo` so the photo albedo survives and GI/AO multiplies it).
`room_clinic_finish` compose + `room-albedo-ao-bake.py` ward pipeline; runtime GLB carries the baked derivatives (packed baseColorTexture), not these sources.
**Keep.** Operator-owned source, approved reference. Replace only if the operator supplies a new approved set.
